newsitem.title: HONG KONG: China's MINMETALS plans 67.5 mln A share IPO.
newsitem.headline: China's MINMETALS plans 67.5 mln A share IPO.

text.p: China's MINMETALS Development Co Ltd plans to make an initial public offering of 67.5 million A shares and list them in Shanghai this year, a company spokesman said on Thursday.

The firm, a subsidiary of China National Metals and Minerals Import and Export Corp, has also applied to the China Securities Regulatory Commission to offer 7.5 million staff shares, he told the Hong Kong-based newsletter China Securities Bulletin.
The firm, which imports and exports mineral products, has appointed CITIC Securities Co as the lead underwriter, he said.
MINMETALS's 300 million outstanding state shares are all owned by the China National Metals, which is under the Ministry of Foreign Trade and Economic Co-operation (MOFTEC), the official said.
Based in Beijing, MINMETALS comprises six 100-percent owned subsidiaries of the China National Metals, he said.
China National Metals, founded in 1950, has evolved into an multi-national involved in foreign trade, finance, real estate development and cargo transport, he said.
The company's annual business turnover averaged five billion yuan in the past three years, the official added.
